description: Fetch one recipe by id. The hash is recomputed (RFC 8785 + SHA-256) before anything is returned. Every response also carries allergens (contains or none_found) and diabetic (friendly, borderline, not_friendly or unknown), both estimates. view: summary, ingredients, process, text or full.

id.description: Recipe id, from search_recipes or query_recipes

include.description: Instead of view: any parts of the recipe, a comma list of summary, ingredients, steps (or recipe, method), nutrition, cost, equipment, notes (history, tips), safety, links (video), all

lang.description: Language code, for example en or ar

servings.description: Scale ingredient quantities and nutrition totals (used with include)

view.description: How much of the recipe to return

name: get_recipe

allergens.description: Allergen screen: status, contains, declared, note

diabetic.description: Diabetic estimate: status, basis, reasons, per_serving

recipe.description: The recipe document or the chosen view

title: Get a recipe
